column3: With respect to the ExchangeRight Net Leased Portfolio #72 Mortgage Loan (3.6%), the borrower may obtain the release of any of the related individual Mortgaged Properties, upon defeasance (at any time after the date that is two years after the Closing Date) of a release price equal to the greater of 115% of the allocated loan amount of the Mortgaged Property being released and 90% of the net sales proceeds of the Mortgaged Property being released. Such release is also conditioned upon, among other things, (i) the debt service coverage ratio following the release must be greater than the greater of 2.11x and the debt service coverage ratio immediately prior to the release, (ii) the debt yield following the release must be greater than the greater of 12.17% and the debt yield immediately prior to the release, and (iii) satisfaction of REMIC related conditions.
